full_judgment: Mohammad Gholam Rabbani, J: Case of the petitioner Saju Hossin formerly Sajede Begun in Writ Petition No. 3002 of 1999 briefly is that she is the owner since 1978 by way of purchase of eight Kattahs of land of C.S. Plot No. 24 appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 209 within mouza Paikpara under P.S. Mirpur of the city of Dhaka. that she obtained a certificate dated 28.11.78 that the land was not a vested property from the A.D.C. (Rev), Dhaka, before her name was mutated in the Revenue Office and that after 21 years thereof suddenly on 5.8.99 a police party led by a Magistrate took forcible possession thereof demolishing the houses and evicting the occupants on the ground that the property was a vested property and that subsequently she got the copy of the eviction order (impugned in this writ petition as annexure 'D') bearing memo No. 956-V.P. dated 29.7.99 issued under the signature of A.D.C. (Rev) Dhaka (respondent No. 2).
